The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.question: ১) Which is the most superficial layer of epidermis of skin?
The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.exp:
Stratum corneum is the outermost (most superficial) layer of the epidermis. It consists mainly of dead, keratinized cells (corneocytes) and provides the skin's main protective barrier.

Epidermal layers from deep → superficial:

Stratum basale → Stratum spinosum → Stratum granulosum → Stratum lucidum → Stratum corneum*

*Stratum lucidum is present only in thick skin (palms and soles).

Exam pearl:
“Most superficial epidermal layer = Stratum corneum.”

The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.question: ২) Which is not true about cornea?
The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.option1: comprises anterior one-sixth of the eye
The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.exp:
The cornea is avascular—it contains no blood vessels. It receives nutrients mainly by diffusion from the tear film, aqueous humor, and peripheral limbal vessels.

  • Cornea → anterior ~1/6 of the fibrous coat of the eye

  • Transparent → true

  • Completely vascular → false

  • Classically 5 layers → true

Five layers of cornea (anterior → posterior):

  1. Epithelium

  2. Bowman's membrane

  3. Stroma

  4. Descemet's membrane

  5. Endothelium

Exam pearl:
“Cornea = transparent + avascular.”

The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.question: ৩) The area of skin supplied by single spinal nerve is called.....?
The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.exp:
A dermatome is an area of skin supplied by sensory fibers from a single spinal nerve root.

  • Dermatome → skin sensation

  • Myotome → group of muscles supplied by a spinal nerve root

  • Sclerotome → embryological mesoderm that forms vertebrae/ribs and related structures

  • Somite → embryological segment that differentiates into sclerotome, myotome, and dermatome

Exam pearl:
“Dermatome = skin; Myotome = muscle.”

The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.question: ৪) Which layer is seen only in thick skin?
The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.exp:
Stratum lucidum is a thin, translucent layer of the epidermis found only in thick skin, particularly on the palms and soles.

The epidermal layers from deep to superficial are:

Stratum basale → Stratum spinosum → Stratum granulosum → Stratum lucidum → Stratum corneum

  • Stratum lucidum → only thick skin

  • Stratum corneum → present in both thin and thick skin

  • Stratum granulosum → present in both

  • Stratum basale → present in both

Exam pearl:
“Lucidum = thick skin (palms & soles).”

The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.question: ৫) Which layer of eye is highly vascularized?
The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.exp:
The choroid is the highly vascular and pigmented layer of the eye. It lies between the sclera and retina and provides oxygen and nutrients, especially to the outer retina.

  • Choroid → highly vascular

  • Cornea → avascular

  • Sclera → relatively poorly vascularized

  • Iris → vascular, but not the principal highly vascular layer of the eyeball

High-yield Eye anatomy recall:
Choroid = vascular + pigmented + nourishes outer retina.

Exam pearl:
“Choroid = vascular layer of the eye.”

The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.question: ৬) The epithelial cells within the organ of Corti are supported by which of the following structures?
The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.exp:
The organ of Corti rests on the basilar membrane, which provides structural support to the sensory and supporting epithelial cells of the organ of Corti.

  • Basilar membrane → supports organ of Corti

  • Tectorial membrane → lies over the organ of Corti and interacts with hair cells

  • Vestibular (Reissner's) membrane → separates scala vestibuli from scala media

  • Spiral ligament → supports the lateral wall of the cochlea

High-yield Ear anatomy recall:
Organ of Corti → on basilar membrane → contains inner & outer hair cells.

Exam pearl:
“Organ of Corti sits on the basilar membrane.”

The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.question: ৭) Langerhans cells present in.....?
The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.exp:
Langerhans cells are specialized antigen-presenting dendritic cells found mainly in the stratum spinosum of the epidermis. They play an important role in cutaneous immune surveillance.

  • Stratum spinosum → Langerhans cells

  • Stratum basale → Merkel cells + melanocytes

  • Stratum corneum → dead, keratinized cells

  • Stratum lucidum → present only in thick skin

High-yield Skin histology recall:
Langerhans → Stratum spinosum → antigen presentation.

Exam pearl:
“Langerhans lives in the spinosum.”

The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.question: ৮) Epithelium of which layer of eyeball secretes aqueous humor?
The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.exp:
Aqueous humor is produced mainly by the non-pigmented epithelium of the ciliary processes, which are part of the ciliary body.

  • Ciliary body → produces aqueous humor

  • Sclera → protective fibrous coat

  • Cornea → transparent, avascular structure

  • Choroid → vascular layer supplying the outer retina

High-yield Eye physiology recall:
Ciliary processes → aqueous humor → posterior chamber → pupil → anterior chamber → trabecular meshwork → canal of Schlemm.

Exam pearl:
“Aqueous humor = ciliary processes.”

The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.question: ৯) Sebaceous glands and sweat glands present in which layer of skin?
The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.exp:
Sebaceous glands and most sweat glands are located mainly in the reticular layer of the dermis. Their ducts may extend toward the epidermis, but the secretory portions are embedded in the dermis.

  • Reticular dermis → sebaceous glands + sweat glands + hair follicles

  • Papillary dermis → mainly loose connective tissue, dermal papillae, capillary loops

  • Epidermis → no glands

  • Subcutaneous layer → mainly fat and connective tissue

High-yield Skin histology recall:
Dermis = Papillary + Reticular
Reticular layer → glands, hair follicles, larger vessels and nerves.

Exam pearl:
“Skin glands are mainly in the reticular dermis.”

The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.question: ১০) Transitional area where the transparent cornea merges with the opaque sclera is called......?
The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.exp:
The limbus (corneoscleral limbus) is the transition zone where the transparent cornea meets the opaque sclera.

  • Limbus → cornea–sclera junction

  • Trabecular meshwork → drains aqueous humor

  • Canal of Schlemm → drains aqueous humor into venous circulation

  • Uvea → iris + ciliary body + choroid

Exam pearl:
“Transparent cornea meets opaque sclera = limbus.”

The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.question: ১১) Which is Antigen-presenting cells (APCs) in skin?
The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.exp:
Langerhans cells are the main antigen-presenting cells (APCs) of the epidermis. They are dendritic cells located mainly in the stratum spinosum and capture antigens before presenting them to T lymphocytes.

  • Langerhans cells → antigen presentation

  • Keratinocytes → barrier + cytokine production

  • Merkel cells → touch sensation

  • Melanocytes → melanin production

High-yield Skin immunology recall:
Langerhans cell = epidermal APC.

Exam pearl:
“Skin APC = Langerhans cell.”

The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.question: ১২) What is the type of human lens?
The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.exp:
The human crystalline lens is biconvex, meaning it is curved outward on both its anterior and posterior surfaces. It is transparent, avascular, and flexible, allowing it to change shape during accommodation for near vision.

  • Biconvex → human lens

  • Biconcave → diverging lens

  • Toric → used to correct astigmatism

  • Cylindrical → used for astigmatism correction

Exam pearl:
“Human lens = biconvex + transparent + avascular.”

The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.question: ১৩) What is the lining epithelium of epidermis?
The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.exp:
The epidermis is composed of keratinized stratified squamous epithelium. Its multiple layers of cells and surface keratin provide protection against mechanical injury, pathogens, and water loss.

  • Epidermis → stratified squamous keratinized

  • Mucosa such as oral cavity → generally stratified squamous non-keratinized

  • Pseudostratified epithelium → respiratory tract

  • Simple squamous → alveoli, endothelium, etc.

Exam pearl:
“Epidermis = keratinized stratified squamous epithelium.”

The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.question: ১৪) What is the lining epithelium of the outer pigmented layer of retina?
The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.exp:
The outer pigmented layer of the retina is formed by a single layer of pigmented cuboidal epithelial cells, called the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE).

  • Retinal pigment epithelium → simple cuboidal

  • Contains melanin, which absorbs excess light and helps prevent internal light scattering.

  • It also supports the photoreceptors metabolically.

Exam pearl:
“Retinal pigment epithelium = simple cuboidal epithelium.”

The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.question: ১৫) What is another name for the stratum germinativum?
The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.exp:
Stratum germinativum is another name for the stratum basale, the deepest layer of the epidermis. It contains actively dividing basal keratinocytes, which continuously generate new epidermal cells.

  • Stratum germinativum = Stratum basale

  • Stratum basale → deepest epidermal layer

  • Contains keratinocytes, melanocytes, and Merkel cells

Exam pearl:
“Stratum germinativum = Stratum basale.”

The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.question: ১৬) Müller cells are present in....?
The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.exp:
Müller cells are the principal glial cells of the retina. They extend across much of the retinal thickness and provide structural, metabolic, and functional support to retinal neurons.

  • Müller cells → Retina

  • Cornea → mainly epithelial, stromal, and endothelial cells

  • Choroid → vascular connective tissue

  • Iris → pigmented and smooth muscle tissues

Exam pearl:
“Müller cells = principal glial cells of the retina.”

The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.question: ১৭) On the human body, the thickest skin is located on the.......?
The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.exp:
The thickest skin of the human body is found on the soles of the feet (and also the palms). This is thick skin, which has a prominent stratum corneum and stratum lucidum.

  • Sole → thickest skin

  • Palm → also very thick

  • Thick skin lacks hair follicles and sebaceous glands

  • It contains numerous eccrine sweat glands

Exam pearl:
“Thickest skin = sole of the foot.”

The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.question: ১৮) The tympanic cavity of the middle ear opens to the ........ via the auditory (eustachian) tube?
The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.exp:
The tympanic cavity (middle ear) communicates with the nasopharynx through the auditory/Eustachian tube. This tube helps equalize air pressure on both sides of the tympanic membrane.

  • Middle ear → Eustachian tube → Nasopharynx

  • Helps maintain equal pressure across the tympanic membrane

  • Also provides drainage of middle-ear secretions

Exam pearl:
“Eustachian tube connects middle ear to nasopharynx.”

The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.question: ১৯) Content of Vascular Tunic or Uvea (Middle Layer) excludes.....?
The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.exp:
The uvea (vascular tunic) is the middle layer of the eyeball and consists of three structures:

  1. Choroid

  2. Ciliary body

  3. Iris

The cornea is part of the fibrous tunic (outer layer), not the uvea.

High-yield Eye anatomy recall:
Uvea = Choroid + Ciliary body + Iris

Exam pearl:
“Uvea = vascular middle coat; Cornea = fibrous outer coat.”

The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.question: ২০) The middle ear contains which of the following structures?
The sense organs, Dermatomes, The skin.exp:
The middle ear contains the three auditory ossicles:

  • Malleus

  • Incus

  • Stapes

They transmit vibrations from the tympanic membrane to the oval window.

  • Labyrinth → inner ear

  • Perilymph → inner ear

  • Vestibular apparatus → inner ear

  • Ossicles → middle ear

Exam pearl:
“Middle ear = 3 ossicles: Malleus → Incus → Stapes.”
